products.stock_readonly_hint: Stock is managed through purchases, sales, and inventory adjustments. Use the ‘Adjust Inventory’ action to change it manually.
products.cost_readonly_hint: Unit cost is calculated automatically (weighted average) from purchases and revaluation adjustments.
products.costing_method_wac_help: Cost is recalculated as a moving weighted average and updated automatically on every purchase. A simple, stable choice that smooths price fluctuations — recommended for most consumer goods and products with relatively stable prices.
products.costing_method_fifo_help: Each purchase creates its own batch at its actual cost; sales consume the oldest batch first. Gives a precise cost of goods sold per transaction — recommended for products with expiry dates or noticeable cost variation between purchases.
products.costing_method_locked_stock: Costing method is locked because this product currently has stock on hand. Reduce stock to zero (sale, adjustment, or return) before changing it.
products.costing_method_locked_consumptions: Costing method is locked because batch movements (sales / adjustments) already exist for this product. Changing it now would mix WAC and FIFO COGS, breaking accounting consistency.
products.costing_method_locked_transactions: Inventory configuration is locked because invoices or stock movements already reference this product. Its unit and tracking policy must remain stable to preserve historical quantities and accounting.
products.tracking_standard_help: Single pool of stock, no lots — the simplest and cheapest option. Recommended for most non-perishable goods (electronics, hardware, apparel).
products.tracking_batch_help: Every purchase creates its own batch (lot) at its actual cost; sales consume the oldest lot first. Recommended for products with cost fluctuations between purchases or where lot-level traceability is required (food ingredients, chemicals, raw materials).
products.tracking_batch_expiry_help: Like Batch, plus an expiry date is required for every purchase. Sales automatically consume the lot expiring soonest first (FEFO). Recommended for pharmacies, supermarkets and any business handling perishable goods. The system will alert you 30/60/90 days before expiry.
products.tracking_locked_stock: Inventory tracking type is locked because this product currently has stock on hand. Reduce stock to zero (sale, adjustment, or return) before changing it.
products.tracking_locked_consumptions: Inventory tracking type is locked because batch movements (sales / adjustments) already exist for this product. Changing it now would orphan the existing lots and break accounting integrity.
products.tracking_locked_transactions: Inventory tracking is locked because invoices or stock movements already reference this product. Create a new product if a different tracking policy is required.
